svg.title: Beacon town — fixed level 0 layout
svg.desc: An authored 29-column by 21-row town, identical for every seed. North: library, sanctuary, storage and forge. Center: beacon square. South: four market shops, two reserved plots and the dungeon gate. All services are closed in the foundation.

g.text: Fixed 29 × 21 tiles · no seed input · rows/columns start at 0 · all buildings initially closed
Quiet Lane: row 6 · Market Street: row 12
Forge Court joins the northeast lane.
Door thresholds are walkable; shops closed.
Every entrance connects to the square.
Town gate travel belongs to story #329.
